51:52.text: Likewise, no Messenger came to those before them but they said: "A sorcerer or a madman!"

51:53.text: ? Nay, they are themselves a people transgressing beyond bounds

51:55.text: (by preaching the Qur’ân, O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم)
, for verily, the reminding profits the believers.

51:56.text: created not the jinn and mankind except that they should worship Me

51:57.text: I seek not any provision from them
(i.e. provision for themselves or for My creatures)
nor do I ask that they should feed Me

51:58.text: Verily, Allâh is the All-Provider, Owner of Power, the Most Strong.

51:59.text: And verily, for those who do wrong, there is a portion of torment like to the evil portion of torment
; so let them not ask Me to hasten on!

51:60.text: Then woe to those who disbelieve
(in Allâh and His Oneness - Islâmic Monotheism)
from their Day which they have been promised

52:4.text: (the house over the heavens parallel to the Ka‘bah at Makkah, continuously visited by the angels)

52:5.text: And by the roof raised high

52:6.text: And by the sea kept filled
(or it will be fire kindled on the Day of Resurrection)

52:7.text: Verily, the Torment of your Lord will surely come to pass.

52:8.text: There is none that can avert it.

52:9.text: On the Day when the heaven will shake with a dreadful shaking,

52:10.text: And the mountains will move away with a

52:11.text: Then woe that Day to the beliers.

52:13.text: The Day when they will be pushed down by force to the Fire of Hell, with a horrible, forceful pushing.

52:14.text: This is the Fire which you used to belie.
